dimensions.assessment: Affects eligible nonprofit organizations applying for security grants through the Department of Homeland Security and administrative grant-making personnel.
dimensions.evidence: ensuring grants awarded under this section are, notwithstanding any other provision of law, awarded in advance, and not on a reimbursable basis

dimensions.assessment: Changes the timing and financial disbursement method of grants for participating nonprofits, reducing upfront financial burdens.
dimensions.evidence: awarded in advance, and not on a reimbursable basis

dimensions.assessment: Does not alter total authorized funding or appropriations levels for the grant program, altering only the disbursement mechanism.
Amends a single paragraph of the Homeland Security Act of 2002 regarding the distribution structure of an existing grant program.
dimensions.evidence: Paragraph (2) of section 2009(f) of the Homeland Security Act of 2002 (6 U.S.C. 609a(f)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Provides a permanent change to how grants under the Nonprofit Security Grant Program are structured and disbursed.

missing_information: Total funding amounts or budget caps associated with the Nonprofit Security Grant Program.
The number of nonprofit entities that receive these grants annually.
importance_detail.rationale: H.R. 10743 amends the Homeland Security Act of 2002 to ensure that Nonprofit Security Grant Program grants are awarded in advance rather than as cost reimbursements.
